title: macOS: Rebuild CoreAudio input AudioUnit when device sample rate changes
body:
WARNING! I've made this fix with assistance of AI (just so you know), but i've tested it heavily with several demo scenarios on my macbook. 

Original problem was, that when you start Godot app and your default input device is 16khz (most bt earphones), mac driver set itself to 16khz and then switching to different input in runtime causes robovoice glitch. Otherwise if you run with builtin mac microphone (44100), and then try to switch to bluetooth mic, you just get -10863 (kAudioUnitErr_CannotDoInCurrentContext) because mac driver is already initialized with different rate. So, this patch is trying to fix this problem by reinitializing mac driver at runtime also checking real device rate, so it would be in sync each time you switch to different input.

I believe it fixes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/106397

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?
Input (audio) problems in macos on device switch

Base of the fix was made in #88628 but those changes is made in such way, that sample rate is read only once and AudioUnit is not reconfigured, but in fact same device can give you different sample rate in runtime (because of switch from A2DP -> HFP) and still, nothing reinitialized core devices before

- Closes #

#### AI usage
I use Claude as a code assistant and search engine to work with Godot's database. My pipeline is such: 
- at first, I try to reproduce the problem in great detail
- next, i'm looking for issue report, to find if anybody but me already stick with similar problems, so, maybe i can fix the problem with other's solutions
- then, i explain to Claude what the problem is and what information I have to reproduce the problem, so it could highlight the points where code goes wrong
- next i read the code, to understand how it handles now
- next i'm thinking of the soultion how it could be fixed
- next i'm writing my solution to claude like it was technical specification
- then i read the solution
- next i'm building engine and making several demos to listen/check if everything is really fixed
- here i found, that my first solution lacks default initialization and fixes only device switch
- making fixes
- once again testing
- yup! Work's well, let's check the code once again
- ok, now lets create the pull request :D
